'''Ord Gallapraxis''' was an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was colonized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime before the [[Pius Dea Era]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
